scope: Standard bundled native asset lookup manifests on Apple, Android, Linux and Windows
behavior: Root NativeAssetsManifest.json is native, excluded from ordinary assets, and compared using decompressed SHA-256.
Mapping changed, added or removed cannot bypass native confirmation through --allow-asset-diffs.
Explicit native override still reports hasNativeChanges.
Unchanged mappings permit canonical Dart payload and structural generated App/base changes.
Nested ordinary assets sharing the manifest filename keep ordinary asset behavior.

local_validation.analysis: Fatal-info checks passed for the nine changed component source/test files
local_validation.shell_failure_probe: Isolated test-command exit 37 propagated through tee and preserved its log

limitations: Real codesign and ditto checks run only on macOS.
Unix permission/symlink writer fixture is skipped on Windows.
This new gate has local execution proof; hosted execution is pending.
Custom legacy mappings embedded solely in Kernel via --native-assets still need recorded compiler-derived provenance.
No physical iOS FFI or new Windows runtime success is claimed.
Existing native override is an explicit acknowledgement, not proof of native equivalence.
